svg.title: Green tests can encode the wrong requirement
svg.desc: Synthetic demo: the original implementation passes its misleading generated test but passes only 3 of 7 independent acceptance checks. The corrected implementation passes 7 of 7. Changing the requirement after a content snapshot is detected.

g.text: The test can agree with the bug.
Requirement: reject blank or whitespace-only justification.
Independent expectations catch 4 misses. Changed evidence also invalidates the snapshot.
